goal: Correct the record-heavy Alch concept model and define a complete bounded product and business ontology.
intent: Preserve the distinct meaning of domain concepts and declaration kinds from authoring through construction.
resolved_corrections: Record is restricted to closed data shape semantics.
Entity, value object, enum, rule, lifecycle, event, action, permission and boundary remain distinct.
Integration and presentation declarations retain their own contracts.
Compiler capability, compiler binding, product capability and domain declaration are separate concepts.
Mapping and Policy are concrete declaration kinds rather than containers for generic compiler descriptions.
claim_ceiling: Candidate semantic completion only; no canonical promotion, compiler adoption, construction admission, release, deployment or effect authority.
